pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with low-contrast, soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area dominates the surface, with geometry varying from roughly rectangular to multi-sided sub-polygons on the flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected pathways of light-colored pixels forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes show clear convergence of three to four pathways with slight thickening at the intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Small-scale jagged contour along the upper cervical ridge where dark mane hairs meet the background, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical displacements.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct, dark, circular focal point of hyper-pigmentation and disrupted texture is present on the upper-mid flank area, contrasting with the surrounding light-brown patch.
